title: wrap_base64 in sign.rs: intermediate Vec allocation before join
description: sign.rs wrap_base64: .collect::<Vec<_>>().join("\r\n") creates an intermediate Vec<&str> just to call .join(). Idiomatic alternative: use itertools::join, or build the string iteratively with a capacity hint. Minor: stable Rust has no Iterator::intersperse that works here without nightly, so the Vec intermediate is necessary for .join() in stable. Not a regression, but worth noting that the pattern allocates O(n/width) strings.
close_reason: The Vec intermediate is necessary in stable Rust — Iterator::intersperse is nightly-only; the current collect().join() pattern is the idiomatic stable approach. Not a regression.
